WGU’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90.75 competency units from other sources can count toward the 121-unit degree.
  • WGU caps alternative credit at 90.75 competency units.

Source: WGU November 2026 undergraduate catalog: transfer ceiling and named degree requirements · Sophia WGU business current partnership table and March2026 change notice

Published university rate: $3,850 per 6 months. The number of paid terms depends on the work you finish. Outside courses and separate charges are additional. See the rate source.

Questions

Does Sophia English Composition I transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia English Composition I for D270 Composition: Successful Self-Expression (3 competency units) in the Accounting – B.S., with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Introduction to Statistics transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia Introduction to Statistics for C955 Applied Probability and Statistics (3 competency units) in the Accounting – B.S., with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Critical Thinking transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia Critical Thinking for D265 Critical Thinking: Reason and Evidence (3 competency units) in the Accounting – B.S., with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Western Governors University’s Accounting – B.S.?

WGU’s published limit for this 121-unit degree is 90.75 competency units from other sources. This plan proposes 72 competency units through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Western Governors University?

In this plan, 49 competency units are taken at WGU, including D196 Principles of Financial and Managerial Accounting, C717 Business Ethics, D102 Financial Accounting, D388 Fundamentals of Spreadsheets and Data Presentations, C237 Taxation I and D081 Innovative and Strategic Thinking and 10 more.

Has Western Governors University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need WGU’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: how many credits must I earn at the school itself for this degree? Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always WGU’s decisions.
